messages:
Maya (oncall): Kicking off a 30m tabletop in 5m. Scenario: simulated multi-region routing failure that causes increased 5xxs and broken streaming in ap-southeast-1 and eu-west-1. Focus: practice paging, concise internal updates, status page + customer note templates, and a timezone handoff. Keep answers short.

Incident-Bot: [simulated] incident created: INC-DRILL-2026-11-04-01
Incident-Bot: Severity: P2-sim. Paging: Maya (oncall).

Maya (oncall): I'm on it. Initial dashboards: p50 ok, p95 elevated ~800ms in ap-southeast, error rate ~15% for streaming endpoints. Dedicated endpoints showing no errors. No recent deploys per deploy-bot.

Priya: I'll pull request logs and check gateway worker queue lengths. Starting log tails.

Eli: I'll draft a compact status page entry and a short customer DM we can use for high-SLA customers. Want to include an option to call a pager for customers with active SLOs.

Comms: I'll be reviewer on customer-facing language. Also flagging Legal for potential regulatory customers in EU. @Legal-Bot please stand by for wording review in the dry run.

Legal-Bot: Acknowledged. Will review for any wording that might imply data loss.

Maya (oncall): Quick triage note: streaming RPCs are timing out; non-streaming sync endpoints return 5xxs intermittently. Gateway logs show increased connection resets to a subset of runner hosts in the two regions.

Priya: Logs show a connection pool exhaustion pattern on gateway side. I'm simulating a fix to increase max connections in the gateway config and will run a small canary.

Eli: Status page draft (short, public tone):
```
Status: Investigating :rotating_light:
Summary: We're investigating increased error rates and degraded streaming performance impacting the hosted API in APAC and EU regions.
Impact: Some customers may experience intermittent 5xxs and truncated streaming responses. Dedicated/Reserved capacity customers are generally unaffected unless traffic is routed through impacted region.
Mitigation: We're routing traffic away from affected runner pools and testing a gateway connection-pool configuration change in canary.
Next update: in 15 minutes.
```

Comms: For high-SLA customers, propose short DM/DM+phone template:
```
Hi <Customer>, we're investigating degraded streaming and intermittent 5xxs in ap-southeast-1 and eu-west-1. We're actively mitigating and will provide an update in 15 minutes. If you'd like a live update, reply and we can schedule a bridge.
```

Legal-Bot: Suggested tweak: remove wording that suggests data loss unless confirmed. Replace "truncated streaming responses" with "interrupted streaming responses".

Eli: Updated the DM per Legal: changed "truncated" -> "interrupted" and added link to status page placeholder.

Maya (oncall): Canary of connection-pool bump looks promising: canary error rate fell from 15% to 2% in ap-southeast canary hosts.

Priya: Confirmed. Pushing simulated traffic redirection script (dry run) to move 60% of traffic off impacted pools. Monitoring.

Incident-Bot: Status page created (simulated): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-DRILL-2026-11-04-01

Eli: Customer update dry-run (short):
```
Subject: Update on Redwood service (investigating)
Body: Hi <Customer>, quick update: routing changes and a gateway configuration test have reduced errors in our canary hosts. We're continuing mitigation and will update within 15 minutes. - Redwood Inference Status
```

Comms: Add a one-liner for on-call handoff notes: current mitigations, canary results, outstanding actions, owners. Put that in the handoff template.

Maya (oncall): Will hand off at +20m to the timezone lead in EMEA. Handoff prep: include traces, canary metrics, config diff, and customer templates. @Priya please attach logs to the incident.

Priya: Uploading canary logs and config diff to the incident doc (simulated). Also adding a quick how-to for reverting the connection-pool change.

Eli: Noting an escalation path for an SLA-sensitive customer: if error rate >10% for >10 minutes, send DM+phone and mark as P1 for comms. Putting that rule in the comms playbook.

Comms: Dry-run of a prioritized customer DM for an SLA customer:
```
Hi <Customer Name>,
We're actively mitigating an issue that may impact streaming. Our on-call is available for a bridge now, or we can follow with a detailed incident timeline when we stabilize. Please let us know your preference.
```

Legal-Bot: Reviewed, no further edits required.

Maya (oncall): Handoff to EMEA lead now. Handoff note (brief):
- What: simulated connection-pool exhaustion caused intermittent 5xxs and streaming interruptions in ap-southeast and eu-west
- Mitigation in progress: gateway connection-pool increase canary + traffic routing away from affected runners
- Canary result: error rate down to ~2% in canary
- Next steps: monitor for 15-20min, prepare permanent config roll or throttle tuning if stable
- Owners: Priya (logs/config), Eli (status + customers), Comms (customer language), Maya (initial oncall)

Eli: Acknowledged handoff. I'll keep status page cadence and prep an evening follow-up for any impacted enterprise customers.

Comms: Retro notes from dry run: what worked: quick alignment on templates, Legal loop-in was fast. Improvements: add pre-approved DM+phone wording to the template library and an auto-insert of status URL into templates. Also, add a short checklist for SLA-sensitive customers (who to ring, time-to-call).

Priya: Tech retro: add a dashboard panel for gateway connection-pool utilization correlated with 5xxs. Also add a runbook step to validate connection pool sizes after deploys that touch gateway configs.

Maya (oncall): Putting incident in monitoring (simulated). If error rate stays <3% for 20m, close and draft RCA stub. Thanks all.

Incident-Bot: [simulated] Incident moved to monitoring by Maya (oncall).

Eli: Action items recap (quick):
- Comms: add DM+phone templates and auto-status-url (due EOD)
- Priya: add dashboard panel + upload canary logs (due tomorrow)
- Maya: prepare RCA stub if closes (monitoring)
- Legal: add quick review checklist for comms templates (due next week)

Comms: :white_check_mark: will follow up on templates.

Maya (oncall): Thanks team. Good practice for handoffs across regions. Closing drill thread. Drop any extra feedback here and I'll fold into the incident comms playbook.
